connectorUiConfig.title: Microsoft Power Automate
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Power Automate is a Microsoft service that helps users create automated workflows between apps and services to synchronize files, get notifications, collect data, and more. It simplifies task automation, increasing efficiency by reducing manual, repetitive tasks, and enhancing productivity. The Power Automate data connector provides the capability to ingest Power Automate activity logs from the Microsoft Purview Audit log into Microsoft Sentinel.

dataTypes.name: PowerAutomateActivity
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PowerAutomateActivity
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

Read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key)

customs.name: Tenant Permissions
customs.description: 'Security Administrator' or 'Global Administrator' on the workspace's tenant.

customs.name: Micorosft Purview Audit
customs.description: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard or Premium) must be activated.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Microsoft Power Automate audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: This connector uses the Office Management API to get your Power Automate audit logs. The logs will be stored and processed in your existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. You can find the data in the **PowerAutomateActivity** table.
